Bundled runtime assets:

- scramjet/ is built from @mercuryworkshop/scramjet 1.1.0.
  Upstream: https://github.com/MercuryWorkshop/scramjet
  The accompanying upstream LICENSE file is included.
- bare-mux/ contains @mercuryworkshop/bare-mux 2.1.9.
  Upstream: https://github.com/MercuryWorkshop/bare-mux
  The accompanying upstream LICENSE file is included.

Epoxy, libcurl, and Bare Server transport modules are loaded from jsDelivr at
runtime. Their licenses and upstream terms apply separately.
